spec_match.rationale: Probes 'type' in GamepadButton.prototype — the exact attribute the w3c/gamepad#196 proposal adds — with baseline getGamepads and interface exposure probed separately, and names the real GamepadButtonTypes runtime feature from runtime_enabled_features.json5.

interactive.rationale: Re-probe button re-reads all four cells live; flag steps show and hide based on the genuine probe result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises exact-surface detection with real flag steps; delivered precisely.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes three failure shapes: no GamepadButton interface at all, baseline-present-but-attribute-absent (flag off), and full support; explicitly rules out blaming browser age.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776 plus explainer, spec PR, and Chromium bug.

conformance.rationale: Suite checks prototype membership AND accessor semantics (getter, no setter), keeps hardware-dependent enum checks as honest manual assertions, and the getGamepads check is the feature's own read path.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: clicked Re-probe; cells read function/function/false with 'attribute not exposed' verdict and visible flag steps; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: gpbt-probe-ran assert reports the three probe readings; console clean.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/rose verdicts on paper background (AA); global button styling untouched.

accessibility.rationale: Native button control; status line is role=status aria-live=polite; probe cells are labelled text pairs, not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Probe grid collapses to one column under 640px; 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000; only network failure is the sandbox-blocked fonts CDN common to the whole site.

openQuestions.title: Verify the flag-on success path on a Chrome ≥152 binary
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the verification environment predates GamepadButtonTypes, so only the honest attribute-absent branch could be exercised. Relaunch a newer Chrome with --enable-blink-features=GamepadButtonTypes and confirm the probe flips true without hardware.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic probe results via live regions; keep controls native.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status line is role=status aria-live=polite; the only control is a native button.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive probe grid small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid with single-column collapse below a min width.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: probe-grid is 1-col under 640px, 2-col above; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): on Chromium 141 the probe honestly reports baseline Gamepad support present and the type attribute absent, shows the exact flag steps, and re-probes on click with a clean console at both viewports. Flag-on verification is environment-blocked and recorded as an open question.
